🚀 Meet Our Team – Galaxy Guardians  🌟

We are a team of enthusiastic nine-year-old Year 5 students from The Winchester School, Jebel Ali, Dubai!

We love space, technology, and exploring the mysteries of the universe! 🌍✨ We enjoy researching, sharing creative ideas, and solving problems together.

We welcome curious and creative teammates who love space exploration

Small Explorers, Big Dreams, Infinite Possibilities! 🚀
